description: Resolve a town, beach, harbour or cove name to Peskio placeIds (Europe, North Africa and US coasts). Call this first whenever the user names a place, then pass the placeId to the other tools. candidates[0] is the best match: when `ambiguous` is false, use it without asking (a harbour or beach listed after a town of the same name is part of that place). Ask which one the user means only when `ambiguous` is true (the same name in different regions). Never ask the user for coordinates.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, lower case, to restrict to one country.

lang.description: The user's language (ISO 639-1; one of Peskio's 15, otherwise 'en'). Picks the peskio.com page language and local place names; answer in the user's language yourself.

query.description: The place name as the user wrote it, optionally with its region.

name: places_search

ambiguous.description: true = ask the user which candidate they mean (same name in different regions, or no exact match).

admin1Label.description: The region name in the requested language (admin1 is its English/official form).

exact.description: A candidate carries the searched name (in any of its languages) and it is candidates[0]. false = Peskio does not have that place; candidates are only similar names.

title: Find a place
